Perfect! All 517 tests pass. 

Fixed two bugs introduced in recent commits:

1. **`src/money.js:16`** — `formatMoney` fractional padding: Changed `padEnd(2, "0")` to `padStart(2, "0")`. The `padEnd` was padding zeros to the right (turning 1 cent into "10"), when it should pad to the left (turning 1 cent into "01").

2. **`src/invoice.js:22`** — Tax calculation: Changed `const taxable = subtotal;` to `const taxable = subtotal - discount;`. Order-level discount codes (like SPRING10) should reduce the taxable amount, not come off after tax.

Both fixes preserve the functionality added by their commits (thousands separators and per-line discount groundwork) while restoring correct behavior.
